name: tiny-dnn
listed_description: A header only, dependency-free deep learning framework in C++11.
reason: No number shows tiny-dnn faster than any named baseline. The README gives one figure with no baseline ('98.8% accuracy on MNIST in 13 minutes training (@Core i7-3520M)'); its 'Comparison with other libraries' wiki page is a feature table with no timings (it only links a video, 'Deep Learning in C++: Comparing tiny-dnn, Caffe, Dynet and other libraries with 1D data'); the AVX backend wiki page is a kernel-support status table; the docs folder has no benchmark page. The only per-operation numbers found are third-party issue #277 'Performance optimization' (opened 2016-08-15, tiny-dnn commit a956613 of 2016-03-15, macOS Xcode, Release -O3, SSE3/AVX, TBB, 1000 iterations averaged), and they show tiny-dnn slower than Caffe: bvlc_reference_caffenet forward 486.034 ms vs Caffe 48.0482 ms, fully connected forward 192.811 vs 16.4621 ms, conv forward 15.6862 vs 1.78803 ms, relu 0.596546 vs 0.066614 ms (tiny-dnn is faster only on LRN, 1.23587 vs 1.52823 ms, and pool, 1.07456 vs 2.38592 ms). No TensorFlow or PyTorch comparison exists. The repo (6k stars, BSD-3-Clause) says it is seeking maintainers.
